issues.title: Jordan Condemns Iranian Attacks on Bahrain, Citing Sovereignty Violation
issues.title_en: Jordan Condemns Iranian Attacks on Bahrain, Citing Sovereignty Violation
issues.summary: Jordan on Wednesday condemned the Iranian attacks on the Kingdom of Bahrain, describing them as a flagrant violation of its sovereignty and a threat to its security, stability and territorial integrity, as well as a clear breach of international law and the United Nations Charter.
